top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs base editing (Liu), a programmed chemical conversion of one DNA base into another without double-strand cleavage and clearly distinct from the 2020 cleavage prize, with sequencing by synthesis on reversible-terminator chemistry (Balasubramanian, Klenerman). Both are simple chemical ideas with demonstrated, wide consequences, the attribution fits within three laureates, and the citations can be scoped to the chemistry and not to platforms. If base editing is found to need Komor and Gaudelli for the two editor classes, a stand-alone three-name prize (P002) is my next choice.
